bibl.title: Naqlun 2016. Hermitage EE.50: preliminary report.
bibl.seg: Włodzimierz Godlewski, Naqlun 2016. Hermitage EE.50: preliminary report.
Polish Archaeology in the Mediterranean. 26/1. Research (Warsaw, 2017) pp. 161-172, figg.
bibl.note: The hermitage, which occupied a small valley, appears to have comprised at least three living units, furnished with rock-cut storage pits in the floor and niches in the walls. The complex may be interpreted tentatively as a residential and religious complex, and it is a good example of a mid-5th century hermitage, the dating confirmed by a study of the pottery assemblage coming from it.
